Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You stand beside your friend, holding a small brightness between them and the dark.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing ally.
Duration
Until the start of your next turn, while the ally remains adjacent and you can act.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Hold your place beside them. Until the start of your next turn, that ally gains 1 Boon to defense while adjacent to you. You must remain able to act; this is one continuing benefit, not a new Boon on every use.
